claim: The narrative widens its expected SPY high-low interval ahead of a scheduled macro release, and the realized range contracts instead.
why_it_might_persist: Not a market inefficiency — a property of the forecaster. A narrative reasons from the size of the surprise to the size of the reaction, but an index absorbs a scheduled release that resolves uncertainty by trading in a narrower band once the number is known. If the heuristic is systematically inverted it will keep being inverted, because nothing in the writing process ever sees the realized range.
observable_prediction: On sessions carrying a preregistered scheduled_event, realized_pct falls below predicted_low_pct more often than chance, and the signed miss is more negative than on sessions with no scheduled event.
falsifier: No difference in signed miss between event and non-event sessions at or above the minimum observation count, or a difference in the opposite direction.
note: Registered after exactly one contradicting session (2026-09-04: interval widened to 0.90-1.35 percent on the August payroll release, realized 0.5005 percent). One session is an anecdote. This file exists so the claim is testable rather than repeatable — the prediction and the falsifier are fixed now, before the sample that would decide it exists.
